description: Quarterly Call Report balances for every FDIC-insured bank with total assets of at least USD 10bn on 2022-12-31, from 2018-12-31 to 2023-06-30.
publisher: FDIC BankFind Suite (financials and failures endpoints)
universe_rule: ASSET >= 10,000,000 (USD thousands) at REPDTE 20221231; fixed before any 2023 outcome is read
pre_event_query: https://banks.data.fdic.gov/api/financials?filters=REPDTE:<quarter> AND ASSET:[5000000 TO *]&fields=CERT,NAME,REPDTE,ASSET,DEP,DEPDOM,DEPUNINS,EQ,SCHA,SCHF,SCAF,SCAA,CHBAL&limit=2000 for each quarter 20181231..20221231, then restricted to the universe
post_event_query: same fields for REPDTE 20230331 and 20230630, selected by certificate so banks that shrank stay in the panel

fields.NAME: institution name
fields.DEPUNINS: estimated uninsured deposits in domestic offices and insured branches in US territories
fields.CHBAL: cash and due from depository institutions

note: A bank with no row for a quarter did not file a Call Report for it: it had failed, merged or closed. Failures are identified only from the FDIC failures list, never inferred from a missing row.
